mechanicTruth: A wheel is held on by the clamping force of all its studs together, so when one shears the remaining studs carry its share unevenly; that is why a lug nut that keeps working loose after being torqued can point to a broken stud rather than a bad nut.
title: Snapped Wheel Stud: Why "Just a Loose Lug Nut" Might Not Be
